Discovery: the plan before the build

In one or two weeks you get a precise plan: what gets built, what it costs and in what order, so no work starts on guesses. An MVP in 1–2 weeks, from UZS 18 mln; the full version in 3–5 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes

Questions

What does “Discovery: the plan before the build” cost?
The MVP costs $1,500–3,500 (UZS 18–42.5 mln), the full version $4,000–9,000 (UZS 48–109 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Discovery: the plan before the build” take?
The MVP takes 1–2 weeks, the full version 3–5 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
The project's code and documents; Access rights; A contact person.
